meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用语法树精准搜索和改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多语言项目中按代码结构而非文本进行搜索和替换
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by syntax tree precisely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search and replace code by structure across multiple languages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 使用 ast-grep 工具基于代码的语法结构（如函数、类、调用）来搜索和重写代码，而非基于文本内容。它支持 25 种编程语言，适合用于结构匹配和确定性代码修改。
howto.when: 当用户询问关于代码结构的问题时触发，例如“找到所有带 Request 参数的函数”、“将 console.log 重写为 logger.info”或“运行 YAML 规则扫描代码”。

say.text: 把项目中所有的 console.log 改成 logger.info。
say.note: Claude 会先用干运行预览改动，然后确认应用。

say.text: 找到所有空的 catch 块。
替换所有 as any 类型断言。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use ast-grep to search and rewrite code based on its syntactic structure (e.g., functions, classes, calls) rather than text. It supports 25 languages and is preferred for structural code matching or deterministic codemods.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks about code structure, such as 'find every function with a Request parameter', 'rewrite console.log to logger.info', or 'run YAML rules for scanning'.

say_en.text: Rewrite all console.log to logger.info in the project.
say_en.note: Claude will dry-run first then apply.
